title: ContextSignal
description: The only conversation-derived data permitted to leave a serving node. Every member is a closed enumeration or a bounded numeric.
$comment:
Defined by SPEC.md §6. There is deliberately no free-text member anywhere in this schema, and scripts/validate.py asserts that mechanically: an unbounded string here is an I1 breach, not a style question.

`local_only` is absent from the signal_class enum by design. A local-only signal is the richer form the node's own classifier produces and is never serialized off-device, so it has no wire representation. An instance carrying signal_class 'local_only' is by construction not a wire object and MUST NOT validate against this schema.
name: dev.uap.supply.context_signal

signal_class.description: The egress class of this signal.
signal_class.$comment:
none      no signal; untargeted or sponsorship inventory only
  coarse    <=3 intent ids at depth <=2, commercial_intent bucketed to 0.1, country geo
  standard  <=5 intent ids at full depth, turn bucket, safety; requires exchange opt-in
See SPEC.md §6.3. `local_only` is intentionally not a member; see the schema $comment.

sensitive_category.description: Whether the turn falls in a suppressing category. Three-valued: true suppresses, false permits, null means undetermined.
sensitive_category.$comment:
null and true are treated identically by a conformant node. source/taxonomy/sensitive-1.0.json requires that a category the classifier cannot confidently exclude is treated as sensitive, and a two-valued flag cannot express that: it collapses 'no evidence found' into 'confidently not sensitive', which is fail-open.

This field exists only to suppress. It MUST NOT be transmitted as a targeting signal, and a suppressed turn produces no AdRequest at all, so in practice the value that reaches an exchange is always false.

classifier_id.description: Identifier of the classifier that produced this signal.

production_ready.description: Whether the classifier has been evaluated against the sensitive taxonomy.
production_ready.$comment: A node MUST refuse to monetise on the output of a classifier that does not assert this, unless the operator has explicitly accepted the risk.

embedding_bucket.description: Locality-sensitive hash bucket over a publicly published projection matrix.
embedding_bucket.$comment: The matrix is published so third parties can audit invertibility. Suppressed when the k-anonymity floor of SPEC.md §6.5 is not satisfied.
